name: Kilitch Drugs (India) Ltd
business_description: Kilitch Drugs (India) Ltd is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of pharmaceutical products. The company generates revenue by producing and supplying formulations such as injectables, tablets, and other dosage forms to pharmaceutical distributors, hospitals, and institutional buyers.
input_sensitivity: Cost risks include fluctuations in prices of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), excipients, packaging materials, energy, and labor costs, all of which directly impact manufacturing margins. Revenue is sensitive to government healthcare spending, regulatory approvals, and demand from hospitals and pharmaceutical distributors, especially in domestic and export markets.
output_note: Pharmaceutical distributors, hospitals, and institutional buyers pay Kilitch Drugs (India) Ltd directly for finished pharmaceutical formulations such as injectables and tablets.
